notes: All sizes include dictionaries, rank/model tables and 16-byte chapter framing; dense sizes exclude search index and hot cache.
Dense KMP correctness uses an auxiliary 2-byte-per-rank normalization table, not included in resource sizes; this could be avoided with per-query rank-variant sets.
Dense word streams preserve spelling/case/punctuation. Direct phrase byte search alone does not implement punctuation-insensitive case-insensitive semantics.
Bloom hashes computed on host; a device implementation can precompute per-word hashes, but their additional storage is not counted here.
Workload terminal leaves are scan-volume proxies, not measured CPU times.

grammar_pruning.note: All top-level Huffman symbols still require decoding. Python scan timings exclude bit decoding and are not Neo timings. Query bitmap can be built bottom-up with no per-terminal bitmap: compare terminal IDs through the existing normalization map.
